# DropEdge

`Flare.Components.DropEdge`

Where a drop landed relative to the item under the pointer.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Before` | `0` | In front of the item under the pointer. |
| `Into` | `1` | On the item itself, or - when no item was under the pointer - in the zone. |
| `After` | `2` | Behind the item under the pointer. |
